last.verdict: Big profit beat and a $20 billion 2027 buyback lifted shares.

reasons.label: Earnings beat
reasons.text: Adjusted profit was $4.23 a share, well above the roughly $3.83 analysts expected.

reasons.label: Refining windfall
reasons.text: Strong refining margins pushed adjusted profit up from $3.52 last quarter; Gulf Coast plants ran at 100%.

reasons.label: Bigger buybacks
reasons.text: Exxon announced $20 billion of 2027 share buybacks and cut net debt to $22.1 billion.

story: After July's small miss, Exxon was dinged for flat oil output and one-time charges. This quarter refining profits did the lifting, with cash flow strong and output still flat near 4.5 million barrels a day. Shares have swung from a small drop to a gain.

history.verdict: Record profit and a small EPS miss left investors cautious; shares slipped.

reasons.label: Slight profit miss
reasons.text: Adjusted earnings of $3.52 a share came in below some analyst forecasts, about $3.60.

reasons.label: One-time hits
reasons.text: $2.6 billion of write-downs and other charges were partly offset by $2.5 billion of timing gains.

reasons.label: Flat oil output
reasons.text: Production was 4.51 million barrels a day, down from 4.59 million last quarter, despite a record Permian.
